lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly visible, roughly circular local maxima of pixel intensity arranged in a staggered grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits and superior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with the circular blobs, defining a coordinate-like grid on the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features running across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple yellow-pigmented organisms with vertical dark bands (high-contrast pixels) clustered near the ventral-lateral gill region and pectoral fin.
